本地日语听写与词库翻译 / Local Japanese speech and dictionary translation

Runtime translation is dictionary lookup plus explicit rules. No neural machine
translation / LLM translation / paid API is used. Speech-to-text alone uses a
local Vosk acoustic/language model, with the user's explicit authorization.

1. Vosk-Browser 0.0.8
   Copyright 2020-2022 Ciaran O'Reilly; WASM bindings by Denis Treskunov;
   Vosk API by Alpha Cephei Inc. Apache License 2.0.
   https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser
   Pinned commit: 4b8eb257503108d96819854d3984372903c2259e
   Full license and dependency notices: VOSK-LICENSE.txt, VOSK-NOTICE.txt.
   Modification: the embedded Base64 worker is extracted as a separate
   same-origin file with LF line endings; the main factory points to it. This avoids
   enabling JavaScript unsafe-eval in the main page. Recognition weights unchanged.

2. vosk-model-small-ja-0.22
   Alpha Cephei Inc. Apache License 2.0.
   https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
   Original: https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models/vosk-model-small-ja-0.22.zip
   Modification: deterministic tar.gz packaging only, all model files unchanged.

3. Japanese-Chinese dictionary data: CC BY-SA 4.0
   JMdict © Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG).
   Used in conformance with https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html
   https://www.edrdg.org/
   Chinese derived glosses © Y1Z, Tomoshi, same CC BY-SA 4.0 license.
   https://github.com/tomoshi-app/tomoshi-dict-data
   Release v2026-10-13, commit 79621e4758f9da9b696d0a9f5f3dd3baad1d9ffa.
   Upstream's Chinese gloss layer includes pre-generated, model-reviewed text.
   Our website performs lookup of that published data; it does not run those
   translation models. Brand names/logos are not licensed or used as endorsement.
   Modifications: entries/forms/zh_defs/freq_rank only; retain written/read forms,
   first available Chinese gloss, first POS and priority as compact JSON shards;
   omit examples and unrelated tables. This derived dictionary is distributed
   under CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
   Upstream attribution/license: JAPANESE-DICTIONARY-NOTICE.txt and
   JAPANESE-DICTIONARY-LICENSE.txt. Exact hashes are in language/v1/manifest.json.

The website's rule engine is separately implemented. Dictionary glosses, word
order and speech recognition can be wrong; these are rough reference captions.
Base language assets come from this website, then use browser-local storage.
Optional versioned preferences are downloaded only on user request from
https://github.com/RoGent-Z/asmr-zh-translation-pack (raw.githubusercontent.com).
Package v0.0.1: 5,433 selected same-sense licensed gloss preferences and no
sentence memories; CC BY-SA 4.0, retaining JMdict/EDRDG and Y1Z/Tomoshi credit.
RoGent-Z selected and restructured preferences using aggregate local corpus
statistics. Source subtitle lines and databases are not redistributed.
Package metadata and notices are available in that repository. This download
uses no account/cookies and is verified before browser-local installation.
No local audio or recognition text is uploaded by this translation feature.
